ROOT CAUSE (WHY + WHERE, tools-first). The residual's witnessing arm is `select_expression_lr_suffix`'s third alternative, `with ( with_covergroup_expression ) ( matches ... )?`; the target-own witness pass IS allotted it (candidate order [1, 2, 0], 4-probe budget at 2 each => branch 2 gets probes 3 and 4), yet 0 of 27 probe samples across the whole run ever carried `with`. The WHY had been UNOBSERVABLE, not merely unlogged: `generate_or` falls back to a sibling when a forced branch fails, and the per-branch `failure_reasons` record that would explain it cannot be emitted from a --report-certificate-coverage run (that path returns at main.rs:1149, and --coverage-output is refused alongside it because it requires --generate-stimuli). Slice 1 built the missing instrument (PGEN_REACH_FORCED_OVERRIDE_DUMP=1, TOOLBOX.md 6.4), which named it on its first run: `forced_branch=2/3 outcome=failed reason="Stimuli generation depth exceeded max_depth=67 while expanding rule 'real_number'"` + `outcome=overridden rendered_branch=0`.

WHERE: `generate_target_own_structure_witnesses` set its depth budget to `reach_prefix_budget + min_derivation_depths[rule]` ONCE PER RULE, outside the loop that then FORCES a specific alternative -- so the budget was scoped to the rule's SHALLOWEST alternative, never to the one being forced. 2*24 + 19 = 67, and the `with` arm descends the full SV expression hierarchy. THE FIX budgets the forced branch by its OWN `min_full_derivation_depth_of_node(alternative) + 1`, reusing `witness_target_depth_budget`'s existing per-BRANCH formula (SV-EXH-PROOF.7.4.6.9) rather than inventing a second one; strictly additive (`.max(budget)`, so no target that witnessed before can stop) and LOCAL to this pass's probes.

⛔ DO NOT 'FIX' THIS BY RAISING --max-depth. Measured on this exact config, the 24/32/40 ladder reaches UNKNOWN=0 at every rung above 24 -- and pays sample_parse_failures 0 -> 8 -> 17, i.e. witness samples the real parser then REJECTS. A global knob cannot pay for a locally mis-scoped budget; it moves the cost to a different column of this same report. The landed fix holds sample_parse_failures at 0.

PROVEN ON AN ISOLATING SYNTHETIC FIRST (docs/tasks/artifacts/engine_universal_services/forced_branch_depth_budget.ebnf, tracked): UNKNOWN 1 -> 0 fully_certified=true at all 9 of --count 1/2/3 x --seed 0/7/42, with zero remaining forced-override events for the target.
